records.title: Stablecoin compliance in 2026: which rules apply to your business
records.summary: A jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction guide to stablecoin compliance requirements for banks, issuers, payments firms, custodians, wallets and card programmes.
records.principal_relevance: Useful reference for regulated digital-asset execution, cross-border compliance and the controls required around financial infrastructure.
records.notes: Local copy states © Sum and Substance Ltd (UK), 2026 and requests attribution when sharing; index links to publisher rather than mirroring the PDF.

records.title: Spatial Artificial Intelligence
records.summary: A SpringerBrief examining AI generated from spatial data, used for spatial analysis, or embedded in physical and digital spatial domains, including robotics and spatial computing.
records.principal_relevance: Relevant to Principal work spanning physical intelligence, edge systems, digital twins and AI operating in spatial environments.
records.notes: Publisher page identifies the 2025 book and author; local binary is not mirrored.

records.title: Human Rights and the Regulation of AI
records.summary: The Joint Committee on Human Rights' fourth report of Session 2026–27 examines AI-related human-rights risks, gaps in existing protections, accountability, oversight and proposals for AI-specific regulation.
records.principal_relevance: Provides a current legislative view of where human oversight, responsibility and redress mechanisms fail around consequential AI use.
records.notes: Local report states publication may be reproduced under the Open Parliament Licence; attribution and licence terms still apply.

records.title: The Islamic Finance Connector Era
records.summary: A financial-institution report on Islamic finance as a connector of regions, liquidity and trusted digital infrastructure across cross-border corridors.
records.principal_relevance: Useful for understanding how governance, settlement rails, legal certainty and interoperability shape cross-border financial execution.
records.notes: Publisher report; local binary is not mirrored.

records.title: The Art of Monetary Policy: Lessons from Sun Tzu for Central Banks
records.summary: Kristin J. Forbes applies strategic principles associated with Sun Tzu to central-bank decision-making, communication, policy instruments and short- versus long-run trade-offs.
records.principal_relevance: Relevant to decision systems under uncertainty, authority expansion, strategic trade-offs and institutional execution.
records.notes: Local file is an MIT Sloan excerpt reprinted with permission from MIT Press; the binary must not be mirrored.

records.title: Risks and controls for multi-agent systems
records.organization: Gradient Institute / Australian Department of Industry, Science and Resources
records.summary: An analytical framework for risks and controls when AI agents interact across organisational boundaries, distinguishing singular, federated and open governance environments.
records.principal_relevance: Directly relevant to Principal's work on delegated authority, cross-organisational agent interaction, structured handoffs and controls at system boundaries.
records.notes: The local report states the public is sublicensed under CC BY 4.0 except specified third-party content, logos, trademarks and the Commonwealth Coat of Arms.

records.title: World Development Report 2026: The Promise of Artificial Intelligence
records.summary: The World Bank's 2026 flagship development report assesses how developing economies can adopt, adapt and advance AI while building local skills, infrastructure and institutional capacity.
records.principal_relevance: Useful for assessing where low-cost local intelligence, institutional capability and multi-provider infrastructure can create value without hyperscale dependence.
records.notes: Canonical World Bank handle is printed in the local copy; binary is not mirrored pending explicit licence review.

records.title: Guidelines on the implementation of the transparency obligations for certain AI systems under Article 50 of the AI Act
records.summary: European Commission guidance on Article 50 AI Act transparency duties for interactive AI, synthetic content, emotion recognition, biometric categorisation and AI-generated public-interest text.
records.principal_relevance: Defines operational transparency and human-review expectations that consequential AI systems and evidence surfaces may need to satisfy in the EU.
records.notes: Official Commission source is linked; no repository PDF mirror.

records.title: AI in European Law: A Deep View
records.summary: An edited legal volume examining AI across EU law, including fundamental rights, public-sector accountability, labour, competition, financial markets and access to justice.
records.principal_relevance: Adds legal depth on the gap between technical conformity, accountability and enforceable rights around AI systems.
records.notes: Local copy is marked Open Access, but redistribution licence and publication year were not established in this pass.

records.title: The 2026 Singapore Consensus on Global AI Safety Research Priorities
records.organization: International Scientific Exchange on AI Safety / IMDA and collaborators
records.summary: A global research-priority consensus on trustworthy, reliable and secure AI, including a companion framework for agentic risk management and multi-agent stability.
records.principal_relevance: Highly relevant to runtime assurance, least privilege, traceable identity, auditability, multi-agent stability and human oversight.
records.notes: Probable duplicate local copies: file_3669B2D8-03CC-4543-AB34-7FA3E2CA6275(1).pdf and file_10139E3E-D349-475B-A859-C9A6729D2D6C.pdf. Source links to the official report site rather than mirroring local PDFs.

records.title: The Authorization Maturity Model: A CISO's Benchmark for 2026
records.summary: A four-stage maturity model for authorization programmes, including per-hop agent authorization, audit readiness, delegation reconstruction and regulatory exposure.
records.principal_relevance: Provides an external industry reference for the authorization layer that Principal/VALO work treats as distinct from authentication and model capability.
records.notes: Publisher page identifies Alex Olivier as author; local ebook is not mirrored.

records.title: AI Mid-Year Outlook 2026: The Productivity Paradox
records.organization: Barclays Private Bank and Wealth Management
records.summary: A thematic investment-strategy outlook on AI productivity, labour-market change, embodied AI and investor decision-making in 2026.
records.principal_relevance: Useful for evaluating the economic timing of AI adoption, physical-AI deployment and where capability gains do or do not translate into productivity.
records.notes: Publisher hosts the PDF; repository stores metadata only.
